tutorial.foundation: Eight foundations, two per suit. They start **empty**; an Ace opens one and it builds up in suit to the King. All 8x13 = 104 cards clears the game.
tutorial.tableau: Eight columns, dealt **four cards each** from the start (the other 72 are the stock). They build **down ignoring suit**, but **only the top card of a column moves**. Dropping the same-suit rule is what gives Diplomat far more landing spots than Forty Thieves.
tutorial.emptyPile: An empty column takes **any card** — the top of another column, or the waste. That makes it your way out of a jam. It cannot be filled straight from the stock.
tutorial.stock: The stock turns one card at a time to the waste, with **no redeal (a single pass)**. Check for a landing spot before letting a card go by.
tutorial.controls: Draw, hint, undo, auto-complete, and the other controls.
